title: How long to boil an egg for soft, medium, and hard
summary: Approximate hot-start timings: 6 minutes soft, 8 medium, 11–12 hard; use a separate timer.

blocks.title: Egg boiling times
blocks.body: Lower large fridge-cold eggs gently into already-boiling water; start timing as they enter and maintain a gentle boil. Start around 6 minutes for soft, 8 for medium, or 11–12 for hard. Egg size, starting temperature and altitude change the result; cool promptly when done.

blocks.heading: Approximate time from entering boiling water
blocks.caption: Move eggs to ice water when time is up, or they keep cooking in the shell.

items.label: Hot-start boiling method
items.detail: Method and approximate soft/medium/hard timing; both comparison pages use the same assumptions.
